dependency_status.external_live_gate: Deferred by release plan: Xorg, THOR, ALFWorld, Coworker and real-provider gates remain concentrated on hkust4 after CL-16d.

allowed_deltas: AgentRuntime.run and canonical batch dispatch are native async and directly await ToolExecutionPipeline
application provider and AgentRuntime contracts require async provider streams; no provider worker-thread bridge remains
ContextAssembler.aprepare awaits LLM compaction while prepare remains only for synchronous unit compatibility
provider wait, resource acquisition, backend execution and verification share one monotonic run deadline
context preparation and provider stream cleanup share that deadline and use bounded cancellation join
the factory injects one application-wide keyed backend resource scheduler into the canonical pipeline
deadline before lease acquisition never marks a backend attempt; mutating execution timeout is outcome_unknown; verification timeout is verification_pending
LegacyExecutorAdapter is the controlled synchronous tool-backend adapter and executes off the owner loop; Coworker thread affinity is owned by CL-16c
test_commands: uv run pytest -q -m 'not live_api and not live_alfworld and not live_mcp and not live_coworker and not stress'
uv run ruff check src tests scripts/v19_release scripts/coworker_demo
uv run python -m compileall -q src tests scripts/v19_release scripts/coworker_demo

evidence.details: ApplicationRuntime directly awaits AgentRuntime; AgentRuntime awaits async provider streams, async context preparation and canonical tool dispatch without asyncio.run or provider to_thread bridges.

Provider timeout, context preparation and stream cleanup share one deadline and cancel/join their async work; resource-wait deadline and cancellation start no backend and leave no active lease; mutating execution timeout or logical cancellation after backend start is outcome_unknown; parent task cancellation propagates unchanged.

A blocked native provider does not block a fast session, same-session turns remain serialized, the application scheduler serializes only matching typed physical-backend keys, cancellation fences stale generation commits, and every resource counter returns to zero.
Frozen provider request hashes, provider commit before tool dispatch, model-view binding, pipeline stage order, evidence ordering, entry parity and retry contracts continue to pass.
1122 passed, 11 deselected, with one existing Starlette/httpx warning; application/tools 164 passed; Ruff, compileall, cleanup guard, upstream manifest and diff checks pass.

findings.summary: The default application pipeline had no application-wide keyed physical-resource scheduler.
findings.reverification: factory injection, same/distinct backend partitioning and production-wired 32-session stress pass with all counters zero

findings.summary: Batch exception isolation swallowed task-level CancelledError and could continue later calls.
findings.reverification: batch cancellation during execution and lease wait propagates and starts no later sibling call

findings.summary: The shared deadline did not cover context summary preparation or provider stream close.
findings.reverification: both operations use bounded deadline cancellation/join and parent cancellation remains CancelledError

findings.summary: Coworker cleanup could skip event futures or the owner-thread fence, and adapter close timeout could not be retried safely.
findings.reverification: cleanup aggregates every failure, always fences, preserves dependency ordering and retry-close regression passes

findings.summary: Coworker event mirroring retained an unbounded owner-thread queue and completed futures.
findings.reverification: adapter queue capacity is bounded, completed futures are pruned, and all failed mirrors are drained

findings.summary: Stress fixtures did not exercise the production scheduler or true stale/fresh resource overlap.
findings.reverification: 32 sessions use the canonical pipeline and 100 races overlap late stale completion with a waiting fresh generation

reviews.disposition: all six findings remediated and verified in the same review round; no second grouped review permitted
